doc_title_en: Notice regarding change in dividend policy and dividend forecast (initial dividend) for fiscal year ending June 2027
doc_title_jp: 配当方針の変更及び2027年６月期の配当予想（初配）に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 過去最高益更新、自己資本比率50%超、One Healthプラットフォーム構築による成長見込み

summary_en: Dividend policy adopted: 20% payout ratio target. Initial dividend of 26 yen/share announced for FY6/27 (period ending Jun 2027), paid as final dividend. No interim dividend. Company rationale: record operating and net profits in FY6/26, equity ratio >50%, balance-sheet strength permitting sustainable distributions alongside growth investment.
summary_jp: 配当方針を採択、配当性向20%を基準。FY6/27初配26円/株（期末配当）。FY6/26最高益達成、自己資本比率50%超、成長投資と配当還元の両立判断。
